ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ فِي الْخَلَا وَالْمَلَا .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Fi ‘l-khalā wa ‘l-malā.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family, in solitude and with company!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ سَادَاتِ أَهْلِ الْعُلَا .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Sādāti ahli ‘l-`ulā.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family, leaders of the highest party!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَ اكْشِفْ لَنَا عَنْ مَقَامَاتِ الْوَلَاءِ وَ الْاِسْتِجْلَاءِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa ‘kshif lanā `an maqāmāti ‘l-walā i wa ‘l-istijlā.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and unveil us to the processions of allegiance and elucidation!
